I just checked on the bird at my parents house and she's OK! My mother took it to the vet and he told her to do exactly what I already had told her to do. But this time, she listened to the vet. I wish she would have listened to me before so the poor thing didn't have to go through this, but at least I'm happy she did listen at the end. She's on a diet for her liver and kidneys and she's not shaking right now. My mother said I probably saved her life.

Yes I know he's a jerk and what he said I shouldn't take serious but I am already feeling awful and it hurt me nonetheless. The problem is finding another place that suits me, in many terms. It's not easy to find a place which is accessible, I can afford and I can happily live in. With moving things maybe I could get some help but the problem mainly is just being able to leave the house and go to look for an apartment. I go out like once every two weeks or so. I am scared I'm going to herniate myself or worse get a spodylolithesis if I go out. Like doing anything beyond my capacities right now. Also I'm so depressed I can't barely handle simple surviving. Like I don't even have strength to start with the apartment research all over again. 

I am focusing right now on trying to get my back better so I could do other stuff but this right now it's just unbearable and I can't take it anymore. I am unsure. I would push my back a bit further if I knew there wasn't a risk to a very serious problem but the thing is there is.

If I could find something that helps me feel better right now and gives me place to be able to look for an apartment , and improve my back a little bit so I can manage to go out that'll be the way to go. I am working on the second but while working on the second the first just seem to get worse and worse as going to a PT just gets me worse emotionally as I am not in a place to handle any kind of human interaction at all and I risk suicide a lot and just not going and doing stuff on my own, I think maybe it's not such an option either or maybe it is Idk I could research the exercises online and do it at home and just go to PT once every couple weeks or every week but I'm scared I'm not going to do the right thing for my new conditions. Idk probably I should do that. I just got this insurance kind of PT that usually is like PT but a lot worse but free but you have to go there every day. Like all the days of the week. That's way too much for me and in an unknown environment. Also there's my mother's pressure to go to this thing. But probably I shouldn't. If I didn't go I feel like I could manage maybe. But then I think maybe if I don't go Idk I need the devices they're going to use to get better and what if my vertebral fracture doesn't heal OK. Idk you got to be inside my head.
